§ 01 · The Program

Real numbers,
real decisions.

From preparing a business budget and securing funding, to reducing operational costs, managing supply chain disruption, and presenting an annual operating plan, every scenario drops you into a genuine finance or operations situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Fifty-one finance-focused scenarios and forty-nine operations-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real financial judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a finance or operations professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across budgeting, cash flow, supply chain, production, and financial reporting.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound financial and operational judgment under pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

Choose your
scenario.

Every scenario contains 10 decision-making questions, a focused introduction, key finance and operations terms to learn, and a practical tip. Search, filter by Finance or Operations, and go at your own pace.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Finance Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping finance and operations professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in finance isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, finance and operations roles in English — Mr. Gad Finance & Operations is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the financial and operational moments you'll actually face.
